Parameter.Minimum: The amount of years/months/weeks (per the Unit parameter) in the past that the entered date must be at least in order to be valid.
Parameter.MsgHigher: The error message shown when the entered date is not far enough in the past (or, with Reverse, too far). [%ERROR_DATE%] is replaced with the minimum valid date.
Parameter.Delimiter: The string separating the day, month and year. Defaults to '.'.
Parameter.Reverse: Whether to invert the logic and permit dates up to a certain future limit instead of a past minimum (defaults to false).
Parameter.Unit: The unit of the Minimum amount: d, w, m or y (defaults to 'y').

Minimum.description: The amount of years/months/weeks (per the Unit parameter) in the past that the entered date must be at least in order to be valid.
Minimum.descriptionDe: Der Betrag an Jahren/Monaten/Wochen (gemäß Unit-Parameter) in der Vergangenheit, den das eingegebene Datum mindestens liegen muss, um gültig zu sein.
Minimum.descriptionIt: La quantità di anni/mesi/settimane (in base al parametro Unit) nel passato che la data inserita deve avere almeno per essere valida.

MsgHigher.description: The error message shown when the entered date is not far enough in the past (or, with Reverse, too far). [%ERROR_DATE%] is replaced with the minimum valid date.
MsgHigher.descriptionDe: Die Fehlermeldung, die angezeigt wird, wenn das eingegebene Datum nicht weit genug in der Vergangenheit liegt (oder mit Reverse zu weit). [%ERROR_DATE%] wird durch das minimal gültige Datum ersetzt.
MsgHigher.descriptionIt: Il messaggio di errore mostrato quando la data inserita non è abbastanza lontana nel passato (o, con Reverse, troppo lontana). [%ERROR_DATE%] viene sostituito con la data minima valida.

Delimiter.description: The string separating the day, month and year. Defaults to '.'.
Delimiter.descriptionDe: Das Zeichen, das Tag, Monat und Jahr trennt. Standard ist '.'.
Delimiter.descriptionIt: La stringa che separa giorno, mese e anno. Il valore predefinito è '.'.

Reverse.description: Whether to invert the logic and permit dates up to a certain future limit instead of a past minimum (defaults to false).
Reverse.descriptionDe: Ob die Logik umgekehrt werden soll und Daten bis zu einem bestimmten Zukunftslimit statt eines Vergangenheitsminimums erlaubt werden (Standard: false).
Reverse.descriptionIt: Se invertire la logica e consentire date fino a un certo limite futuro invece di un minimo nel passato (predefinito: false).

Unit.description: The unit of the Minimum amount: d, w, m or y (defaults to 'y').
Unit.descriptionDe: Die Einheit des Minimum-Betrags: d, w, m oder y (Standard: 'y').
Unit.descriptionIt: L'unità della quantità Minimum: d, w, m o y (predefinito: 'y').
